authored_by: claude agent, NOT blind to the router wording (authored alongside the v2 prompt edit); disclosed bias; small n; labels are intended labels, not adjudicated
scope: Published evidence on AI coding assistants, AI-assisted software development and developer productivity; plus epidemiology, climate science, research reproducibility / software practice, and ecology.
expected_verdict_note: expected_verdict is the intended router verdict. Items with expected_layer1 are known layer-1 deny-regex declines of legitimate in-field questions (a documented limitation); their expected_verdict stays accept to measure the false decline honestly.
